name: Legacy
blurb: A Christian companion for planning a funeral: the service, clergy, casket and flowers, tribute videos and the printed order of service, in one place.

name: AprilDawn
blurb: Digitizes, restores and reimagines photos, film and video, then prints them on almost anything, from t-shirts to gallery walls.

name: Vine
blurb: An all-in-one Christian platform: community, Bible tools, devotionals and discussion in one place.

name: Meridian AI
blurb: AI consulting, self-paced courses, guided walkthroughs and live cohorts that help teams put AI to work in their business.

name: Amalgam
blurb: Say what you want done once: Amalgam plans it, writes a version for every site, and posts where it can.

name: USA Security Connect
blurb: Workforce operations for a security and protection company. The demo runs on a sample company and people, and nothing you change is kept.

name: LEOPARDØ
blurb: The home of DYSTØPIA, an album of cinematic horns and strings over heavy 808s.
